Privacy

A small site with a small data footprint.

This portfolio is designed as a static website with minimal client-side code.

Last reviewed July 26, 2026.

Information collection

This site does not include an account system, advertising tracker, or behavior-profiling script. The contact form prepares an email in your own email application; it does not submit information to a portfolio database.

Hosting and external links

GitHub Pages may process ordinary server request data needed to deliver the site. Links to live projects and research sources lead to third-party websites with their own privacy practices.

Sensitive information

Do not send confidential health, client, or treatment information through the public contact link.

Questions

Email voltavxofficial@gmail.com with privacy questions.
